build_moses_tokenizer: build a MosesTokenizer instance with source and target language args from sacremoses
encode_text_with_moses: encode a string into tokenized text using the MosesTokenizer encode method
decode_text_with_moses: decode tokenized text back into natural language using the MosesTokenizer decode method
add_moses_tokenizer_args: add Moses tokenizer CLI arguments for source language, target language, dash splits, and escape options
register_moses_tokenizer: register the MosesTokenizer class with the fairseq tokenizer registry under the name moses
